verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Locations API doc saying sellers can customize receipts per location with fields like `custom_receipt_text` printed on receipts. That implies Square issues printed receipts but says nothing about how they are issued. missing for 10: evidence of email/SMS digital receipt delivery, documentation of how printed receipts are issued, any statement that receipts meet card-network requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
